title: yunta answers
description:
The answers artifact's document — written by the ENGINE, never an
agent, next to the questions artifact it answers.

Answer.description:
One answer: the question's `id` and the person's value, as text — a
`boolean` answer is the string `true`/`false`, a `choice` one of the
declared `values`.

QuestionId.description: A question id: a letter followed by letters, digits, `_` or `-`
